top_signals.title: Diversified Energy Buys Elliott-Backed Birch for $1.8 Billion
top_signals.summary: Diversified Energy Co. agreed to acquire Elliott Investment Management-backed oil and gas company Birch Resources in a deal valued at about $1.8 billion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Takaichi’s Cabinet reshuffle: What to watch for
top_signals.summary: The reshuffle will impact Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's management of party dynamics, the future of the ruling coalition and her prospects for remaining in power.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
